text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Though she was unable to achieve the 
Triple Tiara, Mejiro Dober felt a distinct 
sense of fulfillment from having given it 
her absolute all.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
For the sake of everyone who supported 
her, she won't shed a single tear! Mejiro 
Dober's challenge now enters a whole new 
stage!
